services.desc: The 15-foot center console boat that can easily take you from the canal to the bay to the beach. Traditional lines and Boston Whaler’s legendary unsinkable hull combine for a smooth, soft ride with up to 60 horses moving it briskly through the water. The roomy layout features a fiberglass leaning post, and an optional fishing package makes it a capable inshore angler. The Montauk 150 is truly a small wonder-as easy to operate as it is to own. This 150 Montauk is powered by a Mercury 60 HP EFI FourStroke Command Thrust engine. It features a white hull, blue graphics & canvas colors and is equipped with a split bow rail, low profile stern rail, bow cushion, fishing package, sun top with boot,
